text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Internal LB health checks failing for customer Private VPCs in region us-central1. Multiple backends marked UNHEALTHY; cross-region routing falling back to benign regions. Auto-escalating to pagers.

alice_oncall: seeing this too — dashboards spiking for 3 customers with Private VPC + cross-region routing enabled. Latency + 5xxs. Paging Ben now.

ben_sre: on it. Can anyone confirm if this is Internal HTTP(S) LB or TCP? Logs show health check failures for port 8080 on backends.

carla_net: looks like Internal TCP LB fronting tunnels between regions. GCP LB control plane is reporting NEG backend health flaps. Also seeing route advertisements from Cloud Router get removed briefly in us-central1 -> us-west1 path.

alice_oncall: customer impact: reported degraded connectivity for Private deployment customers pinned to multi-region routing. No Hosted API customer impact reported.

dave_prod: flagged top 3 affected customers (P1-ish). Eva can you start CS outreach drafts?

eva_cs: on it. Drafting a short note: "We are investigating intermittent connectivity for Private VPC deployments in us-central1 affecting cross-region routing. Engineers are working on mitigation." Will ping for review.

frank_ops: quick status: GCP console shows health check errors 502/timeout across multiple backend VMs. Control-plane errors showing "backend not found" for a few backends then recoveries.

ben_sre: running a targeted check: `gcloud compute backend-services get-health --region us-central1 --backend-service my-private-backend` returns UNHEALTHY across three zones. Collecting packet captures from the affected VM interfaces.

carla_net: I see BGP flap logs on our Cloud Router peering sessions to partner hubs around the same time. Could be route convergence causing health check timeouts.

alice_oncall: timeline: first alerts at 13:42 UTC (thread_ts). Incidents: 13:42 -> 13:55 heavy flaps, then partial recovery, then repeat at 14:06.

ben_sre: mitigation plan proposal: 1) Disable cross-region failover for Private VPCs to force regional routing to local backends; 2) Temporarily increase health-check timeout/interval to reduce flapping; 3) Open case with GCP support. Any objections?

dave_prod: agree with mitigations. Need to be careful: disabling cross-region failover may increase latency but reduces 5xxs. Coordinate with customers.

eva_cs: will send hold message to affected customers before making changes: short ETA and that we may route traffic regionally to stabilize.

frank_ops: preparing automation runbook to flip routing flags for the affected private deployments. Script uses: 
```
# flip to regional-only routing
redwoodctl private update --deployment-id $DEPLOY --routing cross_region=false
```
Will run one at a time per customer.

ben_sre: while we prepare, I'll increase health-check timeout from 10s -> 30s and interval from 5s -> 15s for the affected backend services to reduce churn. Doing one region to validate.

carla_net: note: increasing timeouts may delay detection for real failures. It's OK as short-term. Also contacting network contacts at GCP — opening a priority support case  case# 12345.

incident-bot: :information_source: GCP status page shows no global outage but there is a regional networking issue reported for a subset of load balancing control-plane operations.

alice_oncall: ben — have you validated that KV cache routing and session affinity won't break with the routing flip?

ben_sre: good call. Verified session affinity uses client IP and should remain within region; will add sticky-cookie fallback for affected customers to prevent session loss.

frank_ops: first customer flip complete (cust-42). Observed immediate reduction in 5xx from ~12% -> 0.5% and latency normalized. No errors in user-facing logs.

carla_net: GCP engineer replied on support case: they observed control-plane traffic spikes causing ephemeral removal of NEGs in us-central1 for international peering — they're rolling an update to control-plane and recommend throttling LB reconfigs. ETA 45 minutes.

dave_prod: good. Let's continue with gradual flips and keep CS notes in sync. Eva, update message: include mitigation steps and expected ETA 45m.

eva_cs: updated and sent to affected customers. Template: "We're routing traffic regionally while GCP resolves a regional load balancer control-plane issue. Expected workaround window ~45 minutes. We'll update you as soon as full cross-region routing is restored."

alice_oncall: handoff note for next oncall at 14:25 UTC: mitigation in progress (regional flips done for 2/3 customers), GCP case open, automation ready to flip remaining. Severity: sev2 for affected Private customers.

ben_sre: last flip queued for cust-99. Running now.

frank_ops: cust-99 flip done. Metrics: error rate dropped to baseline. All three customers back to stable regional routing.

carla_net: monitoring: same control-plane flaps observed for unrelated projects; GCP control-plane rollout still ongoing. We'll keep regional routing enforced until GCP confirms fix.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation complete: Regional-only routing applied to affected Private deployments. All 3 customers show healthy backends. Case# 12345 updated.

alice_oncall: next steps: 1) Keep regional routing enforced for 1 hour post-stability. 2) Prepare rollback script to re-enable cross-region after GCP confirms. 3) Postmortem owners: ben_sre + carla_net. 4) Customer follow-up: eva_cs + dave_prod.

ben_sre: starting postmortem doc draft. Key items: timeline, root-cause hypothesis (GCP LB control-plane BGP/NEG eviction during peering bursts), mitigation actions, long-term - implement graceful LB reconfig backoff, reduce automatic reconfig frequency, add routing guardrail to avoid simultaneous flips across regions.

dave_prod: also add communication note for Dedicated customers: check if any similar config could be impacted and advise best practices.

carla_net: filing infra ticket to add a pre-check that pauses cross-region reconfig if Cloud Router peers show instability.

eva_cs: will send a final customer update after 1 hour with root-cause summary and next steps.

alice_oncall: handing off to night oncall (ben on-call) at 14:30 UTC. All mitigations active. If GCP confirms fix we'll coordinate reenable window and test with one customer first.

ben_sre: acked. I'll monitor logs and the GCP case. If anything new, I'll reopen paging.

frank_ops: note for postmortem: include reproducible test that simulates Cloud Router BGP transient flaps and validates LB stability under those conditions.

incident-bot: Thread closed by alice_oncall — will reopen if alerts reoccur.
